test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The teacher will explain the lesson tomorrow.

options.text: The lesson is being explained by the teacher tomorrow.
The lesson was explained by the teacher tomorrow.
The lesson will be explained by the teacher tomorrow.
The lesson will have been explained by the teacher tomorrow

solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. The lesson will be explained by the teacher tomorrow.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The structure for converting an active sentence in the simple future tense to passive voice is: **subject + will be + past participle + by + agent.**
 
• In the given sentence, **"the teacher**" is the subject, **"will explain"** is the verb phrase in the future tense, and "the lesson" is the object.
 
• In the passive voice,** "the lesson"** becomes the subject, "will explain" changes to "will be explained," and "the teacher" becomes the agent prefixed by "by."

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
